topic: Request for data aggregation script run
summary_markdown: Someone requested assistance with running or modifying a data aggregation script to cover the July/August period. [me] offered to provide an updated, centralized version of the script. To proceed, [me] asked for details regarding the required changes, affected parties, dates, and specific data sources (e.g., `*_ml`, `*_ml_staging`). The requester confirmed that both `*_ml` and `*_ml_staging` needed to be updated.
decisions: The aggregation script will be provided in a dedicated, always-current location.
action_items: [me] needs to run the data aggregation script for July/August using the specified sources (`*_ml`, `*_ml_staging`).
